observations: Multiple used-looking car tires stacked in a tire shop setting.
Tire sidewalls show heavy wear/dirt; no clear brand name visible in the provided photos.
Some tires have readable markings only partially (numbers/letters appear but not clearly enough to confirm exact size/model).
No photo shows tread depth clearly or any tire being inflated/checked for leaks.

claims.evidence: Photos do not clearly show a brand/origin marking that confirms 'Belgium' or 'first grade' status.

risks.risk: Exact tire size (and whether they fit your vehicle) is not readable from the photos.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of one tire sidewall showing the full size code (e.g., 195/65R15) and load/speed rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown used tires (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: Condition grade ('first grade') is not verifiable; tires may be heavily worn, unevenly worn, or near end-of-life.
risks.proof: Straight-on tread photo plus a tread-depth measurement (mm) at 3 points per tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn used tires (worst-case: low tread life).

risks.risk: Leak/damage risk (punctures, sidewall cracks, bulges) cannot be assessed from these images.
risks.proof: Photos of sidewalls for cracks/bulges + a quick pressure test result or video of inflation to check for bubbles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires that may need repair/with unknown leak status (worst-case: not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Quantity and whether all tires are the same size/condition is unclear.
risks.proof: Count of tires available and a photo showing all tires laid out with matching size markings visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a set with unknown uniformity (worst-case: mixed sizes/conditions).

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the sidewall for each tire showing the full size code (e.g., 195/65R15) and brand/model if present.
Send tread-depth measurements (mm) for at least 2 representative tires (front and back positions).
Send photos of sidewalls for cracks/bulges and a short video of inflation/pressure test.
Confirm how many tires are included and whether all are the same size.
response.reason: The photos show used tires, but the key details needed to price correctly (exact size/brand and true condition/grade) are not readable or verifiable. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
